ConnectionStrings.//: Aspire injects these at runtime. These defaults let you F5 the WPF app standalone against a local Postgres/Ollama.

Piper.//: Run via Aspire: it builds piper/Dockerfile and injects ConnectionStrings:piper automatically — leave Endpoint empty here.
Piper.//standalone: To use a containerized piper1-gpl yourself: docker run -p 5000:5000 <image> server -m en_US-lessac-medium, then set Endpoint to http://localhost:5000
Piper.//cli-fallback: Only used when no Endpoint/connection string is set (legacy local piper.exe).
